system.description: Drawing upon the rising power of her Essence, the raksha becomes a torrent of Wyld potential, bringing the enlightening madness of Rakshastan into stale and staid Creation. This Charm permanently enhances its prerequisite, allowing the raksha to transform the affected region of Creation into a Bordermarch rather than a tainted land. A second purchase of this Charm at Essence 5+ permits the infliction of Middlemarches, while a third purchase at Essence 6+ permits Creation to be plunged into the febrile instability of the Deep Wyld. A fourth and final purchase at Essence 10 allows Pure Chaos to be brought into the midst of Creation.
